FAQ
A Few Things
Worth Knowing
  • Who is Uniify for?
    Independent artists, producers, and songwriters who want a clearer plan for their music career.
  • What does the assessment cover?
    Six foundations: releases, rights, identity, audience, money, and goals. It checks your practices, not your talent.
  • How is my roadmap created?
    Your answers highlight gaps and suggest practical tasks. You decide what to work on next.
  • Where is my progress saved?
    This demo saves in your browser. Export your data from the dashboard to keep a copy.
  • Does Uniify distribute my music?
    No. Uniify currently helps with assessment, planning, and progress. Distribution and industry placements are not included.
